title: CanvasItem modulate is now the shader input, not a post-process

blocks.text:
In Godot 3, modulate was independent of the shader material and affected
whatever the shader produced in COLOR. In Godot 4, modulate is the input
of the shader material, and whatever is written to COLOR in the shader is
the final result. Migrated sprites that both set modulate and write COLOR
in a custom shader will look wrong without a parse error. See
godotengine/godot#49781.
